metadata.title: Palantir Stock Holds the Line. Wall Street Sees a 24% Gain Ahead.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Stock Holds the Line. Wall Street Sees a 24% Gain Ahead.
Shares of Palantir Technologies haven’t been immune to the artificial-intelligence trade worries of late but the stock has managed to maintain a key technical trading. Wall Street just gave Alex Karp’s company a vote of confidence.
